scope: Round 0 excluded. Every completed decision in each frozen 1..N prefix included. Archived mutation_failures/<round>-attempt-* retries included only for these completed rounds; pending-round work excluded.
token_semantics: Input and output are separate OpenCode step_finish receipt fields, summed across model calls including repeated input context. Reasoning and cache fields are reported separately, never added to output. Preparation and editing are already concatenated in opencode.jsonl; preparation_result.json and agent_audit.json are not separately summed. Stable (sessionID,messageID,part.id) keys deduplicate repeated receipts globally. No missing usage is imputed as zero. Fields ending _mean_per_complete_round use only rounds with complete usage for every identified attempt. The LaTeX table reports these means in separate input and output columns. Fields ending _observed_per_completed_round_lower_bound divide observed totals by all completed rounds, including partially logged rounds. Printed means use ordinary rounding with M/B suffixes.
outcome_semantics: Not retained means any decision accepted=false. Accuracy rejections, infeasible code/execution errors, and unresolved numerical certificates are separate subtypes; uncertified does not establish physical inaccuracy.
